nl.pim16aap2.testing.assertions.LogEventAssert
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.assertj.core.api.Assert<LogEventAssert, nl.altindag.log.model.LogEvent>, org.assertj.core.api.Descriptable<LogEventAssert>, org.assertj.core.api.ExtensionPoints<LogEventAssert, nl.altindag.log.model.LogEvent>
@NullMarked public class LogEventAssert extends org.assertj.core.api.AbstractObjectAssert<LogEventAssert, nl.altindag.log.model.LogEvent>
Represents an assertion class for LogEvent instances.

This class provides methods to assert various conditions on a log event, such as checking for the presence of a throwable, verifying the type of the throwable, and more.
